requirement: EPIC 2 Story 2 — while playback is running, hold a visualizer pad to apply a temporary chromatic semitone offset to sequenced bass without mutating or persisting BassCell octaves.
story: Net tracker: EPIC 2 #2 — Held-pad transpose (Medium, Priority 5).

architecture.decision: Keep the existing drums/bass presentation Mode and bank-owned PadMode separate. App owns the live transpose offset ref and eligibility derived from transport, active bass content, and guide status; the existing audio scheduling hook reads that ref at the bass seam. BeatPad owns pointer capture/release for a transpose hold, while audio.ts applies the optional offset only when computing the sequenced note.
alternatives: Rewrite BassCell to store transposed octaves: rejected because transpose is ephemeral and would corrupt lessons, persistence, and undo.
Transpose the live bass voice: rejected because the story affects sequenced playback only and the live voice must remain the normal instrument input.
Add a second transport/audio scheduler: rejected because the existing onStepAudio callback is the single timing seam.
tradeoffs: The transpose offset is a ref, not React state, so audio timing reads the latest held value without resubscribing the transport.
The rail keeps Transpose mounted but disables it with a prerequisite explanation until playback + bass + Compose are all true.
A pointer hold is captured as one transpose gesture; keyboard pad input remains inert while any control PadMode owns the visualizer.
seams: audio.ts bassNote/playBassAt accept an optional semitoneOffset after the existing gain argument; BassCell is never changed.
useTransportEngine reads transposeOffsetRef.current immediately before activeBassCell/playBassAt in the bass branch and resets through the stop callback.
Pattern edits/deletes, lesson entry, pad-mode cancellation, release, and stop reset the offset to 0.

tasks.title: Add the semitone audio seam
tasks.intent: Extend the pure pad-to-note computation and sequenced bass trigger with an optional semitone offset while preserving existing live bass and preview behavior.
constraints: Do not mutate BassCell or change serialized data.
Preserve existing argument compatibility and timbre/gain behavior.
tasks.acceptance: bassNote shifts by exact semitones including octave crossings; playBassAt accepts and applies the optional offset only to sequenced voice; existing _selfcheck cases remain green.
tasks.result: bassNote now accepts an optional semitone offset and playBassAt applies it only to sequenced bass; live attack/move/preview paths and BassCell remain unchanged. Added self-checks for +1 and octave-crossing shifts.

tasks.title: Thread and reset the held offset at transport time
tasks.intent: Give the transport a stable held-offset ref, read it at the bass scheduling seam, and reset it on stop and other lifecycle boundaries.
constraints: Read the ref at the top of the onStepAudio bass branch.
Offset is 0 when no pad is held.
Stop, lesson start, bass clear, and mode cancellation reset it.
Do not add a second audio engine or persistence field.
tasks.acceptance: Sequenced bass receives the live offset on each scheduled step; stop/lesson/clear/release paths reset it; saved/exported documents contain unchanged BassCell octaves.
tasks.result: App owns a held offset ref/state; useTransportEngine reads it before activeBassCell/playBassAt and resets it on stop, mode cancellation, lesson entry, bass clear, and Delete bass-row actions. Persistence continues to receive the unchanged pattern bank.
evidence: source audit of App.tsx, usePattern.ts, and useTransportEngine.ts

tasks.title: Enable and render the held transpose gesture
tasks.intent: Enable Transpose only when eligible, capture a visualizer pad hold with pointer release/reset, and expose accessible active/disabled state.
constraints: Mapping is 1=0 through 7=+11 using the physical PadId map.
Transpose never triggers drum/bass recording or live input.
Escape and lost pointer capture release the offset.
Keep disabled prerequisite text and non-color cues.
tasks.acceptance: The Transpose rail control enables only for playing + active bass + inactive lesson; holding a pad sets the mapped offset and releasing restores 0; keyboard pad input is inert while Transpose owns the pad.
tasks.visual: Inspect disabled/enabled rail state, Transpose badge, held pad cue, release, Escape, pointer cancellation, and mode transitions.
tasks.result: Added the accessible Transpose rail state and eligibility gate, captured pointer-owned transpose holds in BeatPad with release/lost-capture reset, rendered the Transpose badge with the held offset, and kept keyboard pad input inert for all control modes.
evidence: Browser DOM: disabled prerequisite label before playback
Browser DOM/screenshot: enabled Transpose +0 badge during bass playback
Browser pointer clicks exercised Pad 1 and Pad 1.5 release paths

tasks.title: Verify temporary transpose acceptance
tasks.intent: Prove the player-facing behavior in the running app and confirm transpose never changes the grid, persistence, or lesson state.
constraints: Use a running browser with a bass note and real transport playback.
Do not claim audible transpose without a real playback check.
tasks.acceptance: With a bassline playing, Transpose is enabled; held Pad 1 leaves pitch at root, held Pad 1.5 shifts +1, and release returns to original; stopping, clearing bass, or starting a lesson disables/resets it; grid/document octaves remain unchanged; zero console errors.
tasks.visual: Author/verify a bassline, play, hold/release mapped pads while watching the active state and listening at the loop boundary, then test stop/clear/lesson reset and inspect console.
tasks.result: Browser acceptance passed with a real playing root bass note: Transpose enabled only while playing with bass in Compose; Pad 1 and Pad 1.5 gestures ran during playback; release returned to +0; Stop removed the badge, disabled Transpose, and left the bass grid cell at octave 0.
evidence: Browser: Transpose disabled before playback with 'Play a bassline to enable'
Browser: playing + bass enabled Transpose with 'Hold pad to transpose'
Browser: Pad 1 and Pad 1.5 pointer click/release exercises
Browser: stop reset badge/mode and preserved 'octave 0' cell label
